stage0048_03:r_99b162aa6aa286a2.text: $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$, Captain's Cabin

stage0048_03:r_58fb02434a1c40b2.text: $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$, Captain's Cabin

stage0048_03:r_1c0f94acd5a8a143.text: ～ $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$, Captain's Cabin ～

stage0048_03:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
$$テッサ$$
「...Now then, allow me to say it properly.
　Welcome aboard the $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$, $$千鳥かなめ$$」

stage0048_03:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$テッサ$$
「You seem out of sorts.
　...Did something happen with Sagara, perhaps?」

stage0048_03:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$テッサ$$
「I doubt it, but...
　you didn't mistake this ship's invitation
　for a date invite and get angry, did you?」

stage0048_03:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Besides, just because $$宗介$$'s invite wasn't
　a date, why would that put me in a bad mood!
　Ha... hahahaha!」

stage0048_03:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Welcome, $$かなめ$$.
　First, let me treat you to some tea.」

stage0048_03:r_44f4742c3dcce39a.text:
$$かなめ$$
「So $$テッサ$$'s really the captain, huh.」

stage0048_03:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$$テッサ$$
「That's right.
　You still didn't believe it?」

stage0048_03:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Well, after seeing you fumble at Odaiba...」

stage0048_03:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$テッサ$$
「That was just an unfamiliar place.
　But inside the $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$,
　which is as good as my home...」

stage0048_03:r_a653c8dec4c0f06f.text:
$$テッサ$$
「S-sorry...
　My hand slipped, and the cup...」

stage0048_03:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$$かなめ$$
「...You don't have to treat me like a guest.
　Let's make the tea together.」

stage0048_03:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$$かなめ$$
「So, what is it you wanted to talk about,
　calling me here just the two of us?」

stage0048_03:r_9c206d19bfda4bd5.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Before things get busy,
　I felt I absolutely had to tell you
　about the two of us...」

stage0048_03:r_d60d0818e965232f.text:
$$テッサ$$
「No.
　You and me... it's about $$ウィスパード$$.」

stage0048_03:r_6fd86c96891ea942.text:
$$テッサ$$
「I imagine you've already noticed,
　but I'm one too.」

stage0048_03:r_d80a9688790ed583.text:
$$テッサ$$
「$$ウィスパード$$ are said to be a treasure trove
　of Black Technology.」

stage0048_03:r_7b6f159eeaf4de0f.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Simply put, it's scientific theory and
　technology far beyond modern standards.」

stage0048_03:r_0827963cfd706e8d.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Given the right conditions,
　a $$ウィスパード$$ can draw out
　that Black Technology.」

stage0048_03:r_3f4035fd9db81258.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Have you noticed nothing yourself?
　For example, suddenly being good at
　math and science you used to struggle with...」

stage0048_03:r_567b361a454c4b73.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Huh, I did top my grade on finals, out of nowhere...」

stage0048_03:r_d22851aaafbbf8fc.text:
$$テッサ$$
「That much is just a sign of it.
　As far as I know, you've shown decisive
　power twice now, $$かなめ$$.」

stage0048_03:r_352534f64413d954.text:
$$テッサ$$
「The battles at Hanka and Odaiba...
　Both times you knew things you shouldn't
　have. ...Though I helped, the second time...」

stage0048_03:r_79f2664edb1af798.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Helped, how...?
　That time... when I heard $$テッサ$$'s voice...?」

stage0048_03:r_a62c4e7f3c09f7ed.text:
$$テッサ$$
「That's right.
　What happened then was resonance.」

stage0048_03:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Yes...
　$$ウィスパード$$ can share their thoughts with
　each other through the depths of the mind.」

stage0048_03:r_7a7add80fde475ba.text:
$$テッサ$$
「When you and I deeply feel we need
　each other, that's when it happens.」

stage0048_03:r_2103f6df2ea2e447.text:
$$テッサ$$
「It's an extremely dangerous act.
　Resonance between $$ウィスパード$$ must be
　avoided whenever possible.」

stage0048_03:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Why? I mean, if you really had
　such a convenient power...」

stage0048_03:r_b6f7b219eb4bd64b.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Anything convenient is always a double-edged
　sword. Resonance is, so to speak, sharing
　thoughts. Not talking, not signals, but melding.」

stage0048_03:r_91bf33c27ad39f0a.text:
$$テッサ$$
「It's like a well stirred cup of milk tea...
　Once they're completely mixed, you can't
　separate the tea from the milk again...」

stage0048_03:r_ee220318b96ab538.text:
$$テッサ$$
「In the same way, two people who resonate
　can, with one wrong step, become unable
　to ever separate again.」

stage0048_03:r_ce1b55e526b6277a.text:
$$かなめ$$
「I sort of get it, and sort of don't...」

stage0048_03:r_c304df6888eb78f7.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Sorry, I know it's all so abstract.
　But truthfully, I don't fully understand it either.」

stage0048_03:r_c26958634526e597.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Now then, $$かなめ$$... the reason I'm telling
　you this is that there are people who want
　a $$ウィスパード$$'s power no matter what.」

stage0048_03:r_95fda74613c97b39.text:
$$テッサ$$
「They want you.
　And once they learn about me, me as well...
　They'd stoop to anything for that.」

stage0048_03:r_48f49f6728c15612.text:
$$テッサ$$
「But you're not without help.
　We at $$ミスリル$$ won't allow you
　to fall into enemy hands.」

stage0048_03:r_0ebc5a6f1e0f81bf.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Of course, $c's higher-ups are
　aware of this matter as well,
　and have assigned personnel to it.」

stage0048_03:r_f02c37d91387d0ad.text:
$$かなめ$$
「So that's why $$宗介$$ and everyone from the
　Volunteer Club are at Jindai High.」

stage0048_03:r_9796b3efa401a303.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Heh... but I've never heard of such a
　high-maintenance bodyguard. $$宗介$$ says
　he's protecting me, then blows himself up.」

stage0048_03:r_643b6eebfc0186b3.text:
$$かなめ$$
「That's no different from a mook in a
　sentai show! Still, never boring, so fine! Ahahaha!」

stage0048_03:r_291280e5f7eb9d70.text:
$$テッサ$$
「...So that's how you provoke me, talking
　about a Sagara I don't know...」

stage0048_03:r_1f4337d6d393fc37.text:
$$テッサ$$
「I-I haven't raised the white flag or anything!」

stage0048_03:r_b76524cd840e1d37.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Believe it or not, when Sagara's at
　the base, I see him quite a lot.」

stage0048_03:r_ffe0fca26da5cd38.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Yes.
　Though I can't say what, since it's private.」

stage0048_03:r_bfb27f9eb2f7073e.text:
$$テッサ$$
（Actually, $c's duties keep me busy,
　so I haven't been able to see him much lately...）

stage0048_03:r_859dfa27bcaafe30.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Heh... o-oh, is that so...
　T-that $$宗介$$, huh...」

stage0048_03:r_71ebf05996a4b0fd.text:
$$テッサ$$
「In other words, that makes me even
　with you, $$かなめ$$, seeing him at school.」

stage0048_03:r_6214c11b1bca811e.text:
$$かなめ$$
「T-that's not...!
　He and I aren't like that, it's not...!」

stage0048_03:r_8eaf6f3098ffed12.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Hehe...
　It's about time, isn't it.
　Well then, shall we go?」

stage0048_03:r_2113dcbabdfc758a.text:
$$テッサ$$
「To the $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$'s hangar.」

stage0048_03:r_4b0e43ba6a5f2f5b.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Actually, there are a few things I'd like
　your help with, $$かなめ$$, but first, let's
　fulfill the main reason I invited you.」

stage0048_03:r_4a14ec0c511c7f0d.text: ～ $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$, Hangar ～

stage0048_03:r_bccc48e1964ad22d.text:
$$テッサ$$
「You might not be too fond of
　this sort of thing, $$かなめ$$...」

stage0048_03:r_d1ec2522c87c361d.text:
$$マデューカス$$
「To Miss $$千鳥かなめ$$, who has shown us
　courage, action, and warmth through Captain
　Testarossa's and our squadron's many crises, salute!」

stage0048_03:r_3bc7834a5bf3ee76.text:
$$テッサ$$
「The ones saluting are this ship's crew,
　members of the $$ミスリル$$ West Pacific Fleet I command.」

stage0048_03:r_366814efdc8b5800.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Hearing you were coming, $$かなめ$$,
　everyone insisted on paying their respects.」

stage0048_03:r_9be1a4c10bb62515.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Everyone except Major $$カリーニン$$, whom you
　met at Odaiba, is here to welcome you.」

stage0048_03:r_1c208ca0cbf26f28.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Yes.
　He's currently at a $$ミスリル$$ base, overseeing
　the overhaul of $c's ships.」

stage0048_03:r_5b7ee307a700171a.text:
$$マデューカス$$
「Miss Chidori, what you did is not
　something even a full-fledged soldier
　could do easily. Please be proud of it.」

stage0048_03:r_f5432119677514f7.text:
$$マデューカス$$
「My apologies for the late introduction.
　I am Lt. Colonel $$リチャード・ヘンリー・マデューカス$$.」

stage0048_03:r_4e5c8e989c4a7691.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Lt. Colonel $$マデューカス$$ is right, $$かなめ$$.
　Everyone here is grateful to you.」

stage0048_03:r_adec86483b13599a.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Ah, thanks, thanks...
　Oh my, oh my... thanks so much.」

stage0048_03:r_2cf701bbcde3ec13.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Now then, the ceremony's over.
　We're planning a small party here
　after this, so please join us, $$かなめ$$.」

stage0048_03:r_1fe8564d2b959317.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Yes... that's why I invited you, $$かなめ$$,
　and everyone from $c.」

stage0048_03:r_f527e012803f7f1c.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Actually, today is this girl's...
　the $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$'s first birthday!」

stage0048_03:r_d91d4bc2d52b61c4.text: ～ Inside the $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$ ～

stage0048_03:r_2acc8ade0cc6dfa2.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Say something, would you.
　I'm gonna die of boredom here.」

stage0048_03:r_3dad695c99e9e052.text:
$$シャッコ$$
「I've been told to treat you like
　handling a highly intelligent beast.」

stage0048_03:r_66d4ae3a21caf881.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「That's giving too much credit to a guy
　who screwed up and got captured.」

stage0048_03:r_0c18da7b3a37825d.text:
$$トロワ$$
「I have no interest in you as a person.
　We're just carrying out our duty to watch you.」

stage0048_03:r_63249745ffae61b6.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Sheesh...
　Not like I'd run off, way down on the seafloor...」

stage0048_03:r_abdb034ae8509702.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「I'll endure any torture you want,
　but for now, get me a new guard...」

stage0048_03:r_b025267f22788233.text: ～ $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$, Hangar ～

stage0048_03:r_ec1a06a7023bf72c.text:
$$バナージ$$
「It's been a while, Ms. $$かなめ$$.」

stage0048_03:r_8805f96e52aaa462.text:
$$かなめ$$
「$$バナージ$$ and $$オードリー$$...!
　You both look well!」

stage0048_03:r_7bdb6fecc8b3bde8.text:
$$シン$$
「Usually we're the ones crashing your world,
　but today it's the other way around.」

stage0048_03:r_4bf9b05b5f948170.text:
$$かなめ$$
「It's actually kind of refreshing.
　I get to see a side of you all I don't know.」

stage0048_03:r_eaa52d152f444bfd.text:
$$桂$$
「Enjoy yourself today.
　A lot of $c's crew are people
　you've helped out before.」

stage0048_03:r_b4bc9e9435b58e6f.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Then I won't hold back, and I will!」

stage0048_03:r_b0600ab9a9e8559d.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「A Fire Bomber concert, is it.」

stage0048_03:r_7cbc63dad295f862.text:
$$ファ$$
「I can't believe we're underwater right now.」

stage0048_03:r_07f53c816e0a51f5.text:
$$マッカラン$$
「Aerospace ships and submarines are
　similar in structure, so anyone used to
　one adapts easily to the other.」

stage0048_03:r_2d09c6f6a2d990ea.text:
$$アムロ$$
「It's been a while, Captain $$マッカラン$$.」

stage0048_03:r_0476ffd10c764b0e.text:
$$アムロ$$
「This is Captain $$ゲイル・マッカラン$$.
　Leader of $$宗介$$'s $$ＳＲＴ$$ team,
　callsign $$ウルズ$$ 1.」

stage0048_03:r_48c6c1ecfea6fe4a.text:
$$アムロ$$
「I've crossed paths with him a few times,
　back when Londo Bell and $$ミスリル$$ cooperated.」

stage0048_03:r_2b3479c4cf0680f4.text:
$$マッカラン$$
「Captain $$ゲイル・マッカラン$$.
　I hear my men owe you a few favors.」

stage0048_03:r_e370696b8936b08c.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Likewise.
　$$宗介$$ and the others always help me out.」

stage0048_03:r_9d7b02c5e728b7aa.text:
$$マッカラン$$
「I take it you're not in that Volunteer Club.
　A member wouldn't say something like that.」

stage0048_03:r_d7f1c506e78e55ff.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Ladies and gents, all you dudes and cuties!
　It's finally time for the shipboard bingo bash!」

stage0048_03:r_0c705091f748360e.text:
$$マオ$$
「$$クルツ$$! Do your MC job properly!」

stage0048_03:r_9eb8599304125b2f.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Hahaha! Too bad for every captain
　who can't make it to a party this fun!」

stage0048_03:r_24e1a808a1609a1a.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Never mind our roaring-drunk ladies,
　let's announce the glorious bingo prizes!
　These were all donated by volunteers!」

stage0048_03:r_53128ce8f154fd06.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Fourth prize!
　Provided by Miss $$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$, the Pizza God
　mascot, a Cheese-tan plushie!」

stage0048_03:r_03b5db9ce98fb8d6.text:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「And here I went to the trouble of
　donating a piece of my collection...」

stage0048_03:r_e180b22d18f48d38.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Leave it to me, $$オードリー$$.
　If I win it, I'll give it to you.」

stage0048_03:r_10340119af3ed6db.text:
$$シンジ$$
「Could it be Ayanami wants one too?」

stage0048_03:r_4f0aca6deda07883.text:
$$シンジ$$
「Got it.
　Then if I win it...」

stage0048_03:r_8fe40600ce62dfbc.text:
$$アスカ$$
「There it is...!
　Teacher's Pet favoring Teacher's Pet.」

stage0048_03:r_89766f5ffaa912d4.text:
$$シンジ$$
「Then if I win, you two do rock-paper-scissors.」

stage0048_03:r_c2df6b71e3b4b6ec.text:
$$アスカ$$
「F-fine, I guess!
　It'd bug me to hand it to Teacher's Pet,
　so I am not losing!」

stage0048_03:r_e3d111e8bb190cb1.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Next, third prize!
　Provided by $$サザンカ$$, the $c girls'
　Sealed photo collection!」

stage0048_03:r_050d0532c4b24bfe.text:
$$ヌケ$$
「W-what part of the 'Sealed'
　photo collection is secret, huh?!」

stage0048_03:r_d583fcea31bdad2e.text:
$$ムチャ$$
「It's gotta be like this, or like that!!」

stage0048_03:r_3c3735172a480b72.text:
$$サザンカ$$
「Everyone's happy, so no worries!」

stage0048_03:r_1f418b5594cea300.text:
$$クラン$$
「It's only the guys who are happy!!」

stage0048_03:r_f87fb889124bfaef.text:
$$クルツ$$
「I begged Miss $$サザンカ$$ for this, and even
　paid out of my own pocket to get it!
　No withdrawing it now!」

stage0048_03:r_33f7fd55913419e8.text:
$$サザンカ$$
（It's okay, $$ユノハ$$.
　'Sealed' just means pressure-sealed... it's a
　group photo taken in the airlock.）

stage0048_03:r_4de6ac85c63bac12.text:
$$サザンカ$$
（With the money $$クルツ$$ paid us,
　let's all get something sweet next time!）

stage0048_03:r_4c92652c9b1adf6f.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
（If that's the deal, I'm in, $$サザンカ$$!）

stage0048_03:r_ce90563a934d49fb.text:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
（That turned into a pricey buy for $$クルツ$$!）

stage0048_03:r_4fb296e63cb1fb46.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Next, second prize!
　Provided by $F,
　a Dimension Grizzly fang!」

stage0048_03:r_6d77e72dbbcd7dfe.text:
$$リディ$$
「$n!
　Why do you have something like that?!」

stage0048_03:r_9dc59affd40f32fc.text:
$n
「It's from the prey I took down
　on my 16th birthday.」

stage0048_03:r_0cea115be526a319.text:
$$ゼクス$$
「I'd heard you were a 《$$ビーストハンター$$》,
　but a G Hunter, no less...!」

stage0048_03:r_09ee921a85025fd3.text:
$$ギミー$$
「You don't know, $$ダリー$$?!
　This is why girls...!!」

stage0048_03:r_fae689f2a1057b61.text:
$$竜馬$$
「The Dimension Grizzly is
　the strongest Beast there is.」

stage0048_03:r_91c6d0bb53854ecc.text:
$$ヴィラル$$
「The man who fells it earns
　the title 'G $$ハンター$$',
　and is hailed as a hero.」

stage0048_03:r_42a3149105314ab8.text:
$$シモン$$
「And the Grizzly's fang proves that, while
　also being a lucky charm against hardship.」

stage0048_03:r_62ecd978c667bd29.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「Nngh... to have a chance at one,
　here of all places...」

stage0048_03:r_d441e6cc908ac01b.text:
$$コンロイ$$
「What luck! What an opportunity!」

stage0048_03:r_b2aab8873350ea1f.text:
$$ジョニー$$
「It's often featured in
　'Monthly: A Man's Hunting', after all.
　I can't pass this up.」

stage0048_03:r_653b741d07545dff.text:
$$いぶき$$
「I can't keep up with this at all...」

stage0048_03:r_d584d4b5af55b1cf.text:
$$ノイン$$
「In short, it's a treasure of manly romance, I suppose.」

stage0048_03:r_db0ee69ece206fcd.text:
$$赤木$$
「But if it's already this hyped up,
　the grand prize must be even better.」

stage0048_03:r_f97e6925c9e37332.text:
$$青山$$
「Can't help getting my hopes up now.」

stage0048_03:r_422861e0b8d77d0c.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Now then, thanks for waiting!
　Finally, the grand prize announcement!」

stage0048_03:r_ef16bcaa2b0e0c45.text:
$$クルツ$$
「This is one amazing prize!
　Honestly, I want it myself!」

stage0048_03:r_2b93cca10f1c36a8.text:
$$マオ$$
「Your build-up's too long, lousy MC!」

stage0048_03:r_ac21212c36d2b9ad.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Don't go fainting on me now!
　The prize is...!」

stage0048_03:r_a26e2108358af7a4.text:
$$クルツ$$
「It's a smoooochin' hot kiss
　from Captain Testarossa!!」

stage0048_03:r_9c13714b3efbc7a8.text:
$$エイーダ$$
「What is with all this excitement...!」

stage0048_03:r_96f156e19b53fc09.text:
$$エマ$$
「Just as expected... more than expected, even.」

stage0048_03:r_8a78bcec22029401.text:
$$テッサ$$
「W-Weber!
　I never agreed to that!」

stage0048_03:r_f42017dfce31dea9.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Ehh? But when I told you the plan,
　you said, 'Anything I can help with,
　just ask me'...you said it yourself!」

stage0048_03:r_ef7426919f628d8a.text:
$$オズマ$$
「Forgive my presumption, Captain...
　I was present too, and I did
　hear those words myself.」

stage0048_03:r_3ac462d37e5893ff.text:
$$ルカ$$
「Figured Lieutenant $$キャシー$$'s not around,
　so you're doing as you please.」

stage0048_03:r_d38be46e6cd7a5e5.text:
$$テッサ$$
「That's... I did say that, but...!」

stage0048_03:r_3fe2078328753c16.text:
$$クルツ$$
「If you'd rather not, we could do
　your favorite underwear instead?」

stage0048_03:r_d037ecbc1e348dc9.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Then it's the kiss! Settled!
　Captain's given the okay, so let's go!」

stage0048_03:r_bcd53d14c4785426.text:
$$桂$$
「Sorry, $$ミシェル$$.
　This time, I'm going all in.」

stage0048_03:r_9ca55ea7feca954a.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「What a coincidence, $$桂$$.
　Same here.」

stage0048_03:r_554ae12c4c170253.text:
$$青山$$
「Sheesh... guess I'm the only one who
　can rescue our poor captain here.」

stage0048_03:r_fa59c6df081e6ae4.text:
$$柿小路$$
「No, no, $$青山$$.
　I can't let a playboy like you
　anywhere near Captain Testarossa.」

stage0048_03:r_ca3edf3b8b52aedf.text:
$$朔哉$$
「Even I, who's never caught a break,
　finally got my shot at a comeback...!」

stage0048_03:r_0b3b19cddb871f90.text:
$$デュオ$$
「Whoa, $$カトル$$!
　You're way too pumped!!」

stage0048_03:r_40e4c010d1b35b4c.text:
$$宗介$$
「I'm not in the mood for that.」

stage0048_03:r_c33abf00683a32bc.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「Then face the source of your doubt.」

stage0048_03:r_a684e6cea428e518.text:
$$トロワ$$
「You're not the one due to relieve me.」

stage0048_03:r_cf907a4d5de8b5c9.text:
$$宗介$$
「Just for a little while.
　Let me be alone with him.」

stage0048_03:r_b4fa30f33e84207f.text:
$$シャッコ$$
「We'll be outside the door.
　Call if anything happens.」

stage0048_03:r_4ae9c4bd77494c4a.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「What's wrong, Kashim?
　What do you plan to do, alone with me?」

stage0048_03:r_a84ab0c3c1ba44d4.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Don't tell me this is the shocking twist
　where the righteous $$ミスリル$$ lynches a prisoner?」

stage0048_03:r_83a9e41e15444c69.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「You can't do it, huh...
　Not as you are now.」

stage0048_03:r_7b3a37f5039eb1f6.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「You've gone soft, Kashim.
　Like this, you can't protect a thing.」

stage0048_03:r_cb6d9ee71c24b042.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Ironic, isn't it.
　Having something to protect made you weak,
　and in the end, you can't protect it.」

stage0048_03:r_df349052cd9cdd0c.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Everyone around you keeps on dying!
　Your comrades, that girl of yours,
　and in the end, you too!」

stage0048_03:r_de3cc1f733dcb073.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Can't argue back, can you.
　Guess it hits close to home.」

stage0048_03:r_0835ec3fff318aff.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Deep down, you must be confused too.
　About this change in yourself.」

stage0048_03:r_660c72e627d873c7.text:
$$クルツ$$
「N-45!
　How about that! We're on round nine now,
　looks like some of you are close to bingo!」

stage0048_03:r_5d8b67b5bd8ce190.text:
$$テッサ$$
（A kiss, what should I do...?
　But if it's with Sagara...）

stage0048_03:r_7cf3c91395139f5c.text:
$$かなめ$$
（Huh...? $$宗介$$... doesn't seem to be around...）

stage0048_03:r_6ccd85652ef4ccf1.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Things are heating up!
　Who will the goddess of victory smile on!?」

stage0048_03:r_2e59226caa35f6e5.text:
$$アンディ$$
（N-35! N-35!
　Come on, long shot!）

stage0048_03:r_78d3b2a75e38d6f7.text:
$n
（The one and only finish!
　It's O-62!）

stage0048_03:r_5cb2acefa1e7c7fb.text:
$n
「Uh... I mean... it's not that I want a kiss...」

stage0048_03:r_59ce7fd9524ec8be.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Then are you after the photo book!?」

stage0048_03:r_33f67c683bda9203.text:
$n
「It's just... I thought I'd give
　Miss $$スズネ$$ a Cheese-tan as a present...」

stage0048_03:r_476fb20ab9d18957.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Oh, really?
　I wonder if I should look forward to it.」

stage0048_03:r_6be0d6139fac197c.text:
$$クルツ$$
「All right, here we go!
　Next is B...」

stage0048_03:r_64f25294d71a5d55.text:
$$シュレード$$
「Now that's a bit of a waste.」

stage0048_03:r_b6ca80db4741a62c.text:
$$カレン$$
「No, no!
　I'm not the one who won!」

stage0048_03:r_34a510533cb8a9f5.text:
$$ミサト$$
「In a way... it went to the least meaningful person...」

stage0048_03:r_1afedc9fa466f321.text:
$$アムロ$$
「For a man with one-in-25-billion odds,
　bingo must be child's play, huh.」

stage0048_03:r_9547b3241808695f.text:
$$マオ$$
「Too bad, boys!
　$$テッサ$$'s kiss goes to the ultimate stone-face!」

stage0048_03:r_32b2a8ce24deeb9f.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Th-then, $$キリコ$$...
　please come this way.」

stage0048_03:r_1be6d12f616f04e4.text:
$$桂$$
「All right, $$キリコ$$!
　You're the greatest man alive!!」

stage0048_03:r_0d24e9726dcc79f9.text:
$$竜馬$$
「I just saw your way of life, man!」

stage0048_03:r_da648116badd491a.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Right! Can't force it on someone who doesn't want it!
　This round's winner is void!」

stage0048_03:r_4e91ccecf1dd0f66.text:
$$テッサ$$
（Rejected, of all things...
　$$キリコ・キュービィー$$... I won't forget this.）

stage0048_03:r_668b7114a3ac1d77.text:
$$クルツ$$
「All right, let's shake it off and keep going!
　G-53!!」

stage0048_03:r_ce68dd10a19e01ea.text:
$$クルツ$$
「And the grand prize goes to Captain $$マッカラン$$!!」

stage0048_03:r_075101b23517fbaa.text:
$$ガムリン$$
「Ha ha... I knew it...
　The goddess of luck was never smiling my way...」

stage0048_03:r_13c2ae299018c9ee.text:
$$朔哉$$
「Figures...
　It always turns out like this...」

stage0048_03:r_6f4f8dd80820f5e7.text:
$$マッカラン$$
「Ha ha ha!
　Hearing the losers wail as I receive
　the goddess's kiss, the finest moment of my life!」

stage0048_03:r_6cf1e5ed68d98bd4.text:
$$マッカラン$$
「Of course, ma'am.
　It's an honor.」

stage0048_03:r_d72cc2c0739c9088.text:
$$マッカラン$$
「Ha, truly!
　What a marvelous day!
　I'm a lucky man! Gahahahaha!」

stage0048_03:r_2be6c657d0e12c4b.text: ～ $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$ Corridor ～

stage0048_03:r_7569f965fff4d791.text:
$$かなめ$$
「So this is where you were.」

stage0048_03:r_bde2e27bac7e3317.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Liar...
　You're not acting like your usual self, $$宗介$$.」

stage0048_03:r_0cd6aab432ee5af7.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Moping around like that isn't like you, $$宗介$$.
　So...」

stage0048_03:r_c8b75f3bca245a85.text:
$$宗介$$
「What do you know about me...!」

stage0048_03:r_1a4dc288e81719ee.text:
$$宗介$$
「Don't say what's 'like me' so lightly!」

stage0048_03:r_b8902c992035da79.text:
$$宗介$$
「I'm nothing but a mercenary...!
　All I had to do was carry out
　the missions given from above!」

stage0048_03:r_df10ad0a71c307da.text:
$$宗介$$
「But ever since I started at Jindai High,
　it's been nothing but trouble!
　One mess after another, it's driving me mad!」

stage0048_03:r_9293c52555ba1457.text:
$$かなめ$$
「I-I never... I never asked you
　to do any of this in the first place!
　If it's such a bother, th-then just quit!」

stage0048_03:r_6c41647935e2574a.text:
$$宗介$$
「I can't do that.
　It's the mission I was given.」

stage0048_03:r_ca702b5726ebd4da.text:
$$かなめ$$
「What's that supposed to mean...?
　A mission? That's just...」

stage0048_03:r_51ce1d8caa34c103.text:
$$宗介$$
「...Go back to your room...
　Don't worry about me right now.」

stage0048_03:r_07513334490fbdf9.text:
$$宗介$$
「Ugh! What was that for, $$クルツ$$!」

stage0048_03:r_d90c4affdd742a0e.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Sorry, but I heard it all...!
　And I couldn't stomach your selfishness anymore!
　That's all!」

stage0048_03:r_fa09fad95980b867.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Getting rattled 'cause the enemy said something,
　sulking like a brat and taking it out on a girl!」

stage0048_03:r_f5507082e5c31362.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Guys like you grow up to be the kind of
　husband the whole neighborhood complains about!
　You get me, huh!?」

stage0048_03:r_3c9956c9d519d2a2.text:
$$宗介$$
「I wasn't taking it out on anyone...」

stage0048_03:r_d150caab246bbd7a.text:
$$クルツ$$
「You sure as hell were, you idiot!
　Who makes a sweet girl like that cry!?
　You're a piece of garbage! Think it over!」

stage0048_03:r_b2f67d46499f2bbd.text:
$$クルツ$$
「I don't know what that $$ガウルン$$ guy said,
　but shrug it off, talk to someone, whatever,
　if you're a pro, handle it yourself!」

stage0048_03:r_fc1b13eaa4071b9a.text:
$$クルツ$$
「You're a member of $$ミスリル$$'s... $c...!
　Don't act like you're fighting a war alone!」

stage0048_03:r_b69df689192adfc2.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「...You're in quite a good mood, aren't you, mister?」

stage0048_03:r_e4ae97a37c9b0cce.text:
$$ダニガン$$
「The captain here had the good fortune
　of getting a kiss from Captain Testarossa.」

stage0048_03:r_4cab8ba7b88b6c2a.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Oh...? From that little cutie...」

stage0048_03:r_38f89a2d27debb9e.text:
$$マッカラン$$
「$$ダニガン$$, don't run your mouth.」

stage0048_03:r_20aab898d4d14e51.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Don't say that, captain.
　With bangs-boy and that Kuent-looking guy on watch,
　I'll bore myself to death over here.」

stage0048_03:r_e418ba9e04898c28.text:
$$マッカラン$$
「If you don't intend to talk,
　that's fine by me too.」

stage0048_03:r_88461d9fd17c56e7.text:
$$マッカラン$$
「The reason we put you on the Danaan
　was to keep you from contacting $c's ships.
　We'll handle the interrogation later, in full.」

stage0048_03:r_f79b2ac118e41c1a.text:
$$ダニガン$$
「Captain, I think this man needs
　to be taught a bit of pain.」

stage0048_03:r_d7bf635b7e5f811c.text:
$$マッカラン$$
「Stop it, $$ダニガン$$.
　Even $$ミスリル$$ forbids vigilante justice.」

stage0048_03:r_3f9082480d045564.text:
$$マッカラン$$
「Guh! What are you doing, $$ダニガン$$!?」

stage0048_03:r_312a78dfbb065f65.text:
$$ダニガン$$
「As expected of the Captain.
　Nice dodge on that killing blow.」

stage0048_03:r_9f17991d2b19374c.text:
$$マッカラン$$
「Major $$カリーニン$$ warned us to watch for
　a possible mole, but an $$ＳＲＴ$$ man
　like you, a traitor...!」

stage0048_03:r_9bf1948e282e5587.text:
$$ダニガン$$
「Let me tell you, I'm not the only one.」

stage0048_03:r_cb5e5d90104f7a88.text:
$$マッカラン$$
「$$グェン$$! You too...!?」

stage0048_03:r_8246cdac0973a25f.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Too bad, Captain.
　Guess the goddess's kiss became a
　parting gift for your trip to the grave.」

stage0048_03:r_0a597f4cd9c8309b.text:
$$ダニガン$$
「Preparations are already done.
　We can move right into action.」

stage0048_03:r_833975ddd032dd18.text:
$$グェン$$
「Already took her down too.
　Handy that she was alone in her room.」

stage0048_03:r_1de04d77f1060720.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Relax.
　There's no way that could happen.」

stage0048_03:r_bc2050dd9e12f5a4.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Some trouble must've come up.
　What convenient timing, too.」

stage0048_03:r_e5de816af15aeaec.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Well then, shall we get going.
　To receive something far more precious
　than the goddess's kiss.」

stage0048_03:r_5149abbbcbee6ee4.text: $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$ Command Center

stage0048_03:r_bedf0f18c13c0a97.text: $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$ Command Center

stage0048_03:r_56d65b2dba1b5061.text: $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$ Command Center

stage0048_03:r_31865d3496c34d8b.text: ～ $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$ Command Center ～

stage0048_03:r_3f3b91470236b2a8.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Don't glare like that, you two.
　You're ruining those pretty faces.」

stage0048_03:r_490618028b4c53d6.text:
$$ダニガン$$
「The rest of you better not get ideas.
　We've fully seized this ship's command center.」

stage0048_03:r_1a6f62daa82363ae.text:
$$マデューカス$$
「$$ジョン・ハワード・ダニガン$$, $$グェン・ビェン・ボー$$!
　You...!」

stage0048_03:r_6b6dd25816c18fc5.text:
$$テッサ$$
「No...!
　There's no winning against $$ＳＲＴ$$ men!
　This is an order!」

stage0048_03:r_9d80dc88f241858b.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「As expected of the Captain,
　you know the gap in strength well.」

stage0048_03:r_23cb7be357e8a4e0.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Did you hear that, everyone!
　You'd better not try anything funny!」

stage0048_03:r_60cd511150394b50.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Our cute, cute captain here
　might end up suffering something
　minors shouldn't ever see!」

stage0048_03:r_33e42009af9a0b54.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「If that happens, boy prez and
　$$ＩＣＰＯ$$ kid get scarred for life!」

stage0048_03:r_f72b6d47f9645d8c.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Now... I wonder what that could be?」

stage0048_03:r_0153901fe839b497.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Do you understand the situation?
　The ＵＧ is moving against us!」

stage0048_03:r_d60b2e6806c37bbe.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「No need to worry about that.
　Those bats won't touch us at all.」

stage0048_03:r_7d0527803c131a6e.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Too bad...!
　Those bats aren't our Amalgam machines.」

stage0048_03:r_9d4ee24cdaa2851d.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Though currently, they're taking
　the position of a collaborator.」

stage0048_03:r_003ee7d177c348cf.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Amalgam...
　So that's your organization's name.」

stage0048_03:r_f4f785c3e285cb39.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「That's right.
　At times we aid dictatorships, at others
　become devout believers of $$マーティアル$$...」

stage0048_03:r_eb4bb0599c61e2b2.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「The name is Amalgam...
　Do remember it from now on.」

stage0048_03:r_6f761a8fd9d1f7b4.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「As expected, $$ミスリル$$ doesn't approve...
　But I've no more need
　to keep the Captain happy.」

stage0048_03:r_98c6e74747c3936c.text:
$$テッサ$$
「What do you mean by that?」

stage0048_03:r_7d9f085a5d9c51fd.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Simply put, this ship
　will soon belong to me,
　thanks to the override code on this disc.」

stage0048_03:r_42d73bcdaedb1371.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Those two aren't the only ones who bit.
　Money-hungry people are everywhere,
　even in your HQ's tech division.」

stage0048_03:r_0866340ed1139b99.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Finding one to win over was tough, though.
　$$ミスリル$$ seems like an awfully high-minded outfit.」

stage0048_03:r_65ef57e28bd90298.text:
$$ダーナ$$
「Welcome, Captain $$ガウルン$$.
　Please give your orders.」

stage0048_03:r_8ca795c4c35fc911.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Let's start with an evacuation drill.
　$c's members are in the hangar, right?」

stage0048_03:r_ae4d9169d6ff43a4.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Then, seal the hangar completely.」

stage0048_03:r_821a93f3f890d905.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Now the central command center's
　sealed off completely from outside.
　No hope of help coming. Clever, right?」

stage0048_03:r_8cb00be7cca91c45.text:
$$テッサ$$
（I have to do something... somehow...!）

stage0048_03:r_5557ccda2f7c3f23.text:
$$テッサ$$
（Can you hear me, $$かなめ$$...
　Please listen closely to what I say now.）

stage0048_03:r_48a3f23147fd6b6d.text:
$$テッサ$$
（The $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$'s AI, $$ダーナ$$,
　now recognizes $$ガウルン$$ as captain.
　Normal procedure can't cancel that registration.）

stage0048_03:r_ae273a5479d64978.text:
$$テッサ$$
（Then we've no choice but to take back $$ダーナ$$ directly.）

stage0048_03:r_a38016b9c3d59e6e.text:
$$テッサ$$
（I'll send the key to my room's safe now.
　Take out another key inside, a universal key.）

stage0048_03:r_258a09e5e9761e3d.text:
$$テッサ$$
（And then, $$ダーナ$$'s heart...
　the Deck 3 central computer room,
　the Lady Chapel. Find it.）

stage0048_03:r_4a301748a7930689.text:
$$かなめ$$
（Wait, what's this Lady Chapel...?
　And how do I even get there!?）

stage0048_03:r_c38e739de7ee864a.text:
$$テッサ$$
（My reflexes are zero...
　Only you can do it...!）

stage0048_03:r_e5630cc47dc440b7.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Tch...! She had a gun on her!」

stage0048_03:r_959b2fde0469959d.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「You've got nerve, missy.
　But now I'm good and mad.」

stage0048_03:r_54d7a668750123ea.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Are you going to kill me?」

stage0048_03:r_586ac0e9503b5765.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「...I thought of something better, former captain.」

stage0048_03:r_1d13d9bb6a6d7818.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「AI!
　Change the hangar's air supply settings!
　Fix oxygen at maximum!」

stage0048_03:r_9b8d839e83da7879.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「One spark and boom! Blown to bits!」

stage0048_03:r_95a0cdf4151c12f7.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Before that, everyone in the hangar
　will pass out from oxygen intoxication.」

stage0048_03:r_c2a5e2a9019026a4.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Do you even understand!?
　If you do that, you'll put
　yourself in danger too!」

stage0048_03:r_3c1c81e93f697fb9.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Are you... trying to kill yourself?」

stage0048_03:r_10cbf30c54cfe4fc.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Suicide, huh...
　The world's most lavish suicide.」

stage0048_03:r_d84831042f10325c.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「After all, a ship worth billions of G
　comes along with me. I don't hate
　that sort of thing. Heh heh heh...」

stage0048_03:r_cc01b694a39de719.text:
$$テッサ$$
（This reckless terrorism, even letting
　himself get captured, all of it was
　calculated. But why something this reckless...）

stage0048_03:r_6a5a0a8d6d6a68fd.text:
$$テッサ$$
（$$かなめ$$... you're my only hope now...）

stage0048_03:r_fa54b106906131ec.text: $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$ Mess Hall

stage0048_03:r_64f86b30363f1f4c.text: $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$ Mess Hall

stage0048_03:r_c98d1f9a0e601947.text: $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$ Mess Hall

stage0048_03:r_afa4e4bac1376010.text: ～ $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$ Mess Hall ～

stage0048_03:r_c5f074a439f6c890.text:
$$かなめ$$
（Got the universal key from $$テッサ$$'s room.
　Now I just need to reach the Lady Chapel...）

stage0048_03:r_53add6e443d8a65a.text:
$$ダニガン$$
「What's wrong?
　Try running away.」

stage0048_03:r_447e23c61fa29c56.text:
$$ダニガン$$
「Do that, and you'll live a little longer.」

stage0048_03:r_2b4d4dced3ef5a03.text:
$$ダニガン$$
「That's it!
　Beg for mercy just like that!
　Hands on the floor, scream and cry!」

stage0048_03:r_bee2bfb994ca7365.text:
$$宗介$$
「One shot won't sink you...
　Then...!」

stage0048_03:r_1c42d2bca3a5e3a3.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Sousuke!
　Weren't you locked in the hangar...!?」

stage0048_03:r_b23f4e273f76c5a8.text:
$n
「Thanks to this guy acting on his own.」

stage0048_03:r_6acc4cacd2cf56b6.text:
$n
「Sortie orders came in, but
　this guy said he had to talk to Chidori
　and bolted the hangar, so I chased him.」

stage0048_03:r_fc994d6aae0712cc.text:
$n
「...I'll go back up $$ヒイロ$$.
　You stay with Chidori.」

stage0048_03:r_176fd2544c64e83e.text:
$$宗介$$
「Are you hurt, Chidori?
　Anywhere hurt?」

stage0048_03:r_ae2ea53f43e74074.text:
$$かなめ$$
「...I'm not... some dead weight...!
　I can handle being alone...
　And just now, I wasn't scared at all!」

stage0048_03:r_60e8a3284b8a113b.text:
$$宗介$$
「I'm sorry, Chidori...
　You are not dead weight.」

stage0048_03:r_d4164c459c1c1165.text:
$$宗介$$
「Did you forget?
　You've helped me more than once.
　Without you, I'd have died long ago.」

stage0048_03:r_e745974656b70e6a.text:
$$宗介$$
「Because you're here, I'm standing here.
　So don't say you're fine alone.」

stage0048_03:r_59cb6a337266e5c9.text:
$$かなめ$$
「I need to go to Lady Chapel.」

stage0048_03:r_f3ed55718d2364ba.text: ～ $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$ Lady Chapel ～

stage0048_03:r_95ef381ed0b96982.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Sousuke, you've never been in here?」

stage0048_03:r_c4e4b578079583c5.text:
$$かなめ$$
（$$テッサ$$... I made it...）

stage0048_03:r_6a27ef5c3933ffa2.text:
$$かなめ$$
「This looks older than the Arbalest's TAROS.
　And what's hooked up isn't a Lambda Driver,
　it's this ship's control systems.」

stage0048_03:r_04169fb070591784.text:
$$かなめ$$
「I think I get it now...
　Ah, I see...」

stage0048_03:r_2471e14c1ef0ecac.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Thank you, Mr. Sagara...
　This place will be fine now.
　Will you come save me, next time?」

stage0048_03:r_2e966de2770bb703.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「What the hell is this?
　Did the system switch over!?」

stage0048_03:r_ddda297a7997c73b.text:
$$テッサ$$
「$$ダーナ$$!
　On my mark, launch countermeasures 1 and 2!
　Deep-sea mode!」

stage0048_03:r_fda7edf39e317875.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Full speed ahead, as we are!!
　Then, emergency blow!」

stage0048_03:r_629b0e87b7bc7b76.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「...What kind of trick was that?」

stage0048_03:r_5777cb06f7e0103f.text:
$$テッサ$$
「You don't understand?
　Then it seems $$ダーナ$$
　never trusted you all that much.」

stage0048_03:r_ede6dd5bb2efe029.text:
$$テッサ$$
「This ship is mine now.
　I won't let you have your way!」

stage0048_03:r_91a4ece3cc02badd.text:
$$テッサ$$
「She's the best there is!
　Even if you kill me,
　she'll protect this ship!」

stage0048_03:r_bc5b33fbc100b97b.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Too bad, Kashim!
　We've got the Captain as our hostage...」

stage0048_03:r_f2d72b948cc38cfe.text:
$$テッサ$$
「It doesn't matter, Sergeant Sagara!
　Breach, just as you are!」

stage0048_03:r_3b207a6e3b8e5700.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Well, this is a surprise!
　Ready to throw your life away!?」

stage0048_03:r_5ce10ef5943775df.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Tch...!
　This has turned against me!」

stage0048_03:r_864ee68806b41af1.text:
$$テッサ$$
「I'm fine.
　Just a nosebleed, that's all.」

stage0048_03:r_5c69712b1b3fb77b.text:
$$マデューカス$$
「Captain, don't tell me you foresaw this
　and ordered $$ダーナ$$'s emergency blow?」

stage0048_03:r_f8c886fa821c5334.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Even a beast like that man $$ガウルン$$
　shouldn't be used to a surfacing jolt.」

stage0048_03:r_a4366814d6972533.text:
$$マデューカス$$
「As splendid a job as ever.」

stage0048_03:r_ce4b924038c181a0.text:
$$宗介$$
「$$ダニガン$$ and $$グェン$$ have already
　been neutralized by me, $$ヒイロ$$, and $n.」

stage0048_03:r_1054a335fa977a7a.text:
$$宗介$$
「Also, Captain $$マッカラン$$, who was ambushed,
　suffered serious wounds, but $$ヒイロ$$'s
　first aid saved his life.」

stage0048_03:r_1795607640d74fdb.text:
$$テッサ$$
「$$ガウルン$$ will likely seize an AS from
　the hangar and try to escape.」

stage0048_03:r_e4166e8a5b45cb96.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Hatch, open!
　Order the rest of $c to launch!」

stage0048_03:r_1711e6c6939aa411.text: ～ $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$ Flight Hatch ～

stage0048_03:r_63bcb74b5bb605c9.text:
$$宗介$$
「I'm grateful for your help, $$ヒイロ$$.」

stage0048_03:r_b661c876eb7a4d72.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「I only did what I wanted to do.」

stage0048_03:r_99128140e453d460.text:
$$宗介$$
「...Is this thanks for the fruit-flavored one?」

stage0048_03:r_3e40a7aae6a7ebad.text:
$$宗介$$
「But without you and $n's assist,
　retaking the $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$
　or beating $$ガウルン$$ would've been impossible.」

stage0048_03:r_d4488f1ef5175d87.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「...There's just one thing I want to say.」

stage0048_03:r_722be3d36da4979c.text:
$$宗介$$
「Is that how you live your life?」

stage0048_03:r_99e939138611b349.text:
$$宗介$$
「Let me say it once more.
　Thank you, $$ヒイロ$$.」

stage0048_03:r_b8aead2ff492ad33.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「That's right...
　Stay just as you are.」

stage0048_03:r_e18660f45e2bdaae.text:
$$デュオ$$
「You've changed, huh.
　Fussing over others like that.」

stage0048_03:r_c01f3d97d765f442.text:
$$カトル$$
「Isn't that fine, $$デュオ$$?
　It's because the world and people change
　that things keep going on.」

stage0048_03:r_f2a506c32c68b595.text:
$$トロワ$$
「But some men can't accept that.」

stage0048_03:r_366eed12d0fa7297.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「...$$相良宗介$$...
　You may be the answer $$五飛$$ sought.」

stage0048_03:r_53dd6bae12e095c3.text:
$$宗介$$
「Chidori... is your body all right now?」

stage0048_03:r_bccb0c4cb58aa146.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Yeah...
　Seems like $$テッサ$$ and I are both fine.」

stage0048_03:r_0ee1b4c987332e23.text:
$$かなめ$$
「I hear this ship floating on the sea
　like this is pretty rare.」

stage0048_03:r_86a99be7bc977b4a.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Feels like we really came to the sea, as promised.」

stage0048_03:r_83e0e74db0ae4d4f.text:
$$宗介$$
「I need to apologize to you about that.」

stage0048_03:r_d45ebbbfa8153f69.text:
$$宗介$$
「Apparently my words were improper and made
　you uncomfortable. Kallen and the others
　gave me quite the harsh scolding for it.」

stage0048_03:r_518305c95e4d1da4.text:
$$宗介$$
「That... I'm not quite sure I follow, but
　it seems I gave you unwarranted expectations.」

stage0048_03:r_78ebe98c49194738.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Don't worry about that.
　In the end, you kept your promise anyway.」

stage0048_03:r_85121e18387bbee9.text:
$$宗介$$
「No, the sea I want to show you is different.」

stage0048_03:r_5cf3d385c6d4b8d0.text:
$$宗介$$
「I promise you again.
　Someday, I'll take you there.」

stage0048_03:r_808269c7e458f2a5.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Though I'm not expecting too much.」

stage0048_03:r_3d395121b4205722.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Just kidding.
　But before that, promise me...
　you'll come back alive from the fights ahead.」

stage0048_03:r_9496bdb991cf236a.text:
$$宗介$$
「That, I swear.
　With you, I feel like I can do anything.」

stage0048_03:r_980e935235423ee4.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Do you really mean that?
　Not just thinking I'm a hassle?」

stage0048_03:r_dc9b1e7f62a8afc8.text:
$$宗介$$
「Of course.
　I can say that clearly now.」

stage0048_03:r_a93aa11c23414e87.text:
$$宗介$$
「Because you're here, I am who I am now.」

stage0048_03:r_a9e024bdcd6975b2.text: ～ $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$, Captain's Cabin ～

stage0048_03:r_978bd43401f7be8a.text:
$$カレン$$
「Is that all right?
　Leaving $$宗介$$ and $$かなめ$$ alone together?」

stage0048_03:r_e9bd6b1804d36e0a.text:
$$テッサ$$
「This time's an exception.
　Miss $$かなめ$$ saved this child of mine.」

stage0048_03:r_1f65c397b9d1833d.text:
$$カレン$$
「You're such a sweetheart, $$テッサ$$.」

stage0048_03:r_7aac40a4f34dcec3.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Not really.
　Even now I'm holding back
　from ordering a crash dive.」

stage0048_03:r_371b88cba6c82378.text:
$$カレン$$
「Don't worry, $$テッサ$$.
　While we're at Jindai High, I'll make sure
　$$かなめ$$ doesn't steal a march on you.」

stage0048_03:r_4cb558f092561fde.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Is that all right, Miss $$カレン$$...?」

stage0048_03:r_119dbefe27cdac46.text:
$$カレン$$
「I'm $$かなめ$$'s friend,
　but I'm $$テッサ$$'s friend too.
　I want you both to fight fair and square.」

stage0048_03:r_e174d36b825c4290.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Thank you, Miss $$カレン$$!
　Whenever you want the Guren refitted,
　please, leave it to me!」

stage0048_03:r_56176fc60ad96ecd.text:
$$カレン$$
「Thanks.
　When that time comes, I will.」

stage0048_03:r_204e41a08c5ec720.text:
$$テッサ$$
「We just received word from $$ラー・カイラム$$.
　It seems the Union of Orb Emirates is under
　attack by a large UG force.」

stage0048_03:r_3569c3ca91ae0f9d.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Coordinating with Amalgam...
　and now this major offensive...」

stage0048_03:r_497aca854c5f874d.text:
$$テッサ$$
「It seems the UG has finally moved in earnest.」

stage0048_03:r_1797d61f82be363c.text: $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$ Hangar

stage0048_03:r_f2e19618032127d3.text: $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$ Hangar

stage0048_03:r_9d5428667d48c806.text: $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$ Hangar

stage0048_03:r_21454fd877c0ae7b.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well done, Master $$宗介$$.
　You splendidly defeated your archenemy.」

stage0048_03:r_c8c3a682c9917367.text:
$$宗介$$
「$$ＡＧ$$... I owe you an apology too.
　Sorry for taking it out on you.」

stage0048_03:r_f612b6b60810e300.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「No, no, I'm just a cheap little robot,
　so if it helps everyone relieve stress,
　I'll be a punching bag as much as you like.」

stage0048_03:r_09068a6fd74f79b7.text:
$$宗介$$
「I do wonder about that, though...」

stage0048_03:r_4ff0d278b79d1168.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Collecting Z-Chips matters most to me.
　And today, Master $$宗介$$, beating your archenemy
　solo generated quite a lot of Z-Chips.」

stage0048_03:r_b101d62bbac1b33b.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The total... a whopping 150 Z!
　I'll add it to the squad's stock, then.」

stage0048_03:r_05b808b1583f5be2.text:
$$宗介$$
「I see...
　Glad I could help.」

stage0048_03:r_6bdc8a8243c655ed.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「So, as thanks for that as well,
　feel free to hit me all you like?」

stage0048_03:r_72be9250b889c959.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Or does Master $$宗介$$ prefer being hit?
　In that case, Miss $$かなめ$$'s paper fan
　would count as a reward, I suppose.」

stage0048_03:r_402b4aaf0ee30986.text:
$$宗介$$
「...Not taking it out on you,
　just righteous anger, well-deserved.」

stage0048_03:r_2cfc9851abe4070e.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Ah...! Um...!
　Please, no firearms, if you would!」

stage0048_03:r_f581e32ff0b84e01.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「$n... are you heading out to sortie?」

stage0048_03:r_c5ffa17ba0fae8d3.text:
$n
「The enemy's UG.
　Maybe I'll find a hint for
　triggering GAI Mode this time.」

stage0048_03:r_b251d2d3a7cdba85.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Now that you mention it, past activations
　happened during battles with UG's
　$$アンナロッタ・ストールス$$, didn't they.」

stage0048_03:r_abc1d4645695a0e0.text:
$n
「I'm counting on you, $$ＡＧ$$.
　This time, figure out the trigger conditions.」

stage0048_03:r_ae527ac0a641a269.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That's rare of you,
　$n, to ask me for a favor so honestly.」

stage0048_03:r_b76534e2de5b6334.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Not to borrow Master $$ヒイロ$$'s words,
　but perhaps $n is changing too.」

stage0048_03:r_eb56670c83981cc6.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「But there are unchanging things too.
　Love, courage, hope, dreams, justice...
　And a dimensional merchant's trading spirit...!」

stage0048_03:r_90b6cb0493a2982b.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「So, energized as ever today... business, business!」

stage0048_03:r_357749a704e3cf55.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「By the way, about the Dimension Grizzly fang
　$n offered up for the bingo tournament...」

stage0048_03:r_9da55d8320b82bc6.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Since the winner, Miss $$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$, wasn't interested,
　we took it back in trade and have
　listed it on this D-Trader.」
